title: Best ManyChat Alternatives
intro: ManyChat still owns comment-to-DM automation on Instagram, but the March 2026 pricing overhaul cut the free tier from 1,000 contacts down to just 25, and per-contact overage fees have Reddit threads describing bills growing 2-3x as lists scale. Here's where to look if that pricing shift changed the math for you.

entries.blurb: Per-workspace pricing instead of per-contact, with a genuinely usable free tier (2 seats) and the same WhatsApp/Instagram/Messenger coverage bundled with a real shared inbox and email.

Covers the same WhatsApp, Instagram, and Messenger channels but is built around a full AI agent with CRM read/write permissions rather than ManyChat's flow-builder automation model — a different tool for a more support-heavy (vs. marketing-heavy) use case.
